findings.message: The visible river meanders, but swimming uses one fixed 22m-wide rectangular Area at z=-24. Away from the bridge, visible water and water physics diverge. Replace it with sampled/segmented volumes following _river_bank_pair(), then test enter/exit at bridge and meander extrema.

The capture still reads as a huge empty lawn with isolated toy trees. The forest mass begins too far behind the river to frame the opening, so the required layered, human-scale grove is not achieved. Add coherent close/mid-ground foliage and understory outside the route corridors, then recapture the opening.

Photographic leaf texture on rounded low-poly canopy meshes remains visibly incompatible with the toy silhouettes, striped trunks, ground, and characters. This fails the cohesive material/asset-language gate. Use a stylized foliage material compatible with the mesh, or replace the trees with compatible textured models.

The river remains a visually flat dark-cyan strip with hard shoreline edges; shallow-bank/deep-channel and current cues are not legible in the live third-person evidence. Strengthen visible shore/depth contrast and motion, then retain evidence from both bridge approaches.

Bridge coverage proves node existence only, not traversal. A deck/ramp seam, rail overlap, or terrain mismatch can still block the real player while all tests pass. Add bidirectional CharacterBody3D physics traversal coverage and live walk evidence.

The roof caps visibly improve the gable, but the distant capture does not show the door or verify its 2.2m collision alignment. Add a close open/closed door capture plus player passage test before claiming the house repair verified.
